coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Zhangqiu district property-registration and natural-resources administration under Jinan.

remainingUncertainty: The current public viewer/API route, access controls, parcel schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity and citywide coverage remain unresolved. Official pages establish custody and inquiry procedures but not an open vector parcel service. WAF/TLS failures and a general catalog result are access limitations, not evidence that Zhangqiu lacks cadastral data.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect an officially exposed Jinan/Shandong map viewer from an allowed network and only test a bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry query if the viewer reveals one; do not infer absence from these access failures.
